'''Nap Socker''' was a [[Newcomer]] employed as a smelter worker on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] while stranded there, accidentally creating a [[Force storm (weather)|Force Storm]], Nap and his employer, [[Tinnin Droo]], were severely burned when the smelter overturned on them. Nap may not have survived, something that troubled Luke deeply.
